subject: general
question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: All actors are professionals. All professionals are creative. Some creative people are lazy.

Conclusions:

I. Some actors are lazy.

II. All actors are creative.
solution:
Given Statement:

All actors are professionals.

All professionals are creative.

Some creative people are lazy.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d979c75a723601c4c43fc920a05c626229afa0b1c04df124ddca49497c32807.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some actors are lazy - False (Because, although all actors are creative, and some creative people are lazy, there is no definite relation given between actors and lazy people. So it can be possible only.)

II. All actors are creative - **True** (Because, all actors are professionals and all professionals are creative, therefore all actors are definitely creative.)

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
